description: This file implements a stat cache for a web server, using splay trees for caching file system stat information, with optional support for filesystem monitoring via inotify, kqueue, or FAM. It manages cache entries, handles filesystem events, and provides functions for cache initialization, cleanup, and querying.

classes.name: stat_cache
classes.description: Main structure for caching file system stat info, including engine type and splay tree of files.

classes.name: stat_cache_fam
classes.description: Structure for filesystem monitoring via FAM, inotify, or kqueue, managing directories and watch descriptors.

classes.name: fam_dir_entry
classes.description: Represents a monitored directory or symlink, with reference counting and metadata.

classes.name: stat_cache_entry
classes.description: Represents a cached file or directory stat, including metadata, etag, content type, and reference count.

methods.name: stat_cache_init
methods.description: Initializes the stat cache, optionally setting up filesystem monitoring.

methods.name: stat_cache_free
methods.description: Frees all cache entries and monitoring resources.

methods.name: stat_cache_xattrname
methods.description: Sets the extended attribute name used for MIME type detection.

methods.name: stat_cache_choose_engine
methods.description: Selects the caching engine based on configuration string.

methods.name: stat_cache_mimetype_by_ext
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: stat_cache_mimetype_by_xattr
methods.description: Returns MIME type from extended attribute.

methods.name: stat_cache_content_type_get_by_xattr
methods.description: Gets content type, possibly from extended attribute or extension.

methods.name: stat_cache_content_type_get_by_ext
methods.description: Gets content type based on file extension.

methods.name: stat_cache_path_stat
methods.description: Returns stat info for a given path.

methods.name: stat_cache_path_isdir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: stat_cache_path_contains_symlink
methods.description: Checks if a path contains symlinks.

methods.name: stat_cache_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache entry for a given path.

methods.name: stat_cache_get_entry_open
methods.description: Retrieves or opens a file descriptor for a cache entry.

methods.name: stat_cache_etag_get
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the ETag for a cache entry.

methods.name: stat_cache_update_entry
methods.description: Updates cache entry with new stat info.

methods.name: stat_cache_invalidate_entry
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry, forcing re-stat on next access.

methods.name: stat_cache_delete_dir
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries under a directory.

methods.name: stat_cache_trigger_cleanup
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of old cache entries and monitoring.
